notablePrerequisites: Triskelavus has at least one +1/+1 counter on it.
description:
Activate Triskelavus by paying {1} and removing a +1/+1 counter from it, creating a 1/1 Triskelavite artifact creature token.
The Triskelavite enters the battlefield, triggering Mana Echoes and Cathars' Crusade.
Resolve the Mana Echoes trigger, adding {C} for each Triskelavite you control.
Resolve the Cathars' Crusade trigger, putting a +1/+1 counter on each creature you control.
Repeat.
Once you have infinite Triskelavite tokens, you may sacrifice them to deal infinite damage to any target(s).
